JWT の署名器を移した後も、JWKS の取得、Client Assertion と DPoP の検証が OAuth2 の型とリプレイ保存ポートを使う。技術的な検証への入力と、OAuth2 の型からの変換を分ける必要がある（D5、D6）。
support_http はテナントを解決し、ratelimit/db_postgres、salts_memory、salts_postgres は Tenancy のポートからテナント ID を読み、db_memory は Tenancy の型を使う。これらは wi-73604 で解消する（D1、D5）。

Application links an OAuth2 client record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). OAuth2 publishes a write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

Application links a SAML service provider record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). SAML publishes a write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

Application links a WS-Federation relying party record to the application it creates by writing application_id in the same transaction that creates the application, so a partial commit cannot leave an unlinked protocol configuration (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). WS-Federation publishes a write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

IdManagement records the CSV import audit event in the same transaction that commits the user or group import, so a committed import cannot lack its audit record (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). Audit publishes a record write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

IdManagement writes the password history of a password set by user CSV import in the same transaction that commits the imported user, so reuse checks cannot miss an imported password (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). Authentication publishes a history write that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.

IdManagement enqueues the group reconcile job in the same transaction that commits the group CSV import, so a committed import cannot lack its reconciliation (docs/design/data/database.md#所有と書き込みの境界). Jobs publishes an enqueue that joins the caller's transaction (D2, D7) in wi-88544.
